name: Sharkdropship & affiliate for AliExpress
author: Marc dooder

sections.description:
Sharkdropship for AliExpress is a powerful WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates with our Chrome extension to help you build, manage, and grow your AliExpress-based online store.

🎥 Watch the full video tutorial:

🎥 Watch the Bulk import from AliExpress:

🚀 Complete Solution for:
* AliExpress dropshipping businesses
* Affiliate marketing stores
* Product import automation
* Performance tracking and analytics

🔧 How It Works:
1. Install the plugin and Chrome extension
2. Browse AliExpress for products
3. Click the Sharkdropship button to import
4. Customize and publish to your store
5. Track performance and optimize

📊 Key Features:
* Advanced analytics dashboard
* One-click product import
* Automated price markup calculations
* Performance tracking (views, sales, revenue)
* Bulk import capabilities
* Full WooCommerce integration
* Product customization tools

🎯 Perfect For:
* Dropshipping entrepreneurs
* Affiliate marketers
* E-commerce store owners
* Online business startups

⚡ Chrome Extension Features:
* Import product variants (size, color, model)
* Extract original and custom images
* Import titles, descriptions, and specifications
* Bulk import capabilities
* Advanced product editors
* Automated pricing formulas

🛠️ Requirements:
* WordPress 5.0+
* WooCommerce 5.0+
* PHP 7.4+
* Chrome browser with our extension

Start your AliExpress business today with Sharkdropship!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sharkdropship-aliexpress directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress admin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Install the Chrome extension from the Chrome Web Store
  4. Access your dashboard from the WordPress admin menu
  5. Start importing products from AliExpress
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use this plugin?

Yes, Sharkdropship for AliExpress requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated on your WordPress site.

Is the Chrome extension free?

The Chrome extension is included with the plugin and is free to use.

Can I import products in bulk?

Yes, the Chrome extension supports bulk import of product variations and multiple products at once.

Does the plugin track sales and revenue?

Yes, the plugin provides comprehensive analytics including product views, sales counts, and revenue tracking.

Can I customize imported products?

Absolutely! You can edit product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and all other details before publishing.

Is there support available?

Yes, we provide comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, and dedicated support for all users.

Can I use this for affiliate marketing?

Yes, the plugin is perfect for creating affiliate stores that promote AliExpress products for commissions.

What countries does this work in?

The plugin works worldwide wherever AliExpress and WooCommerce are available.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all data is stored locally on your WordPress site and we don’t collect any personal information.

Can I test products before committing?

Yes, you can save products as drafts and test them before publishing to your live store.
